VinFast is expected to report a revenue of $1.06 billion with a revenue surprise percentage of +0.64%. Park Aerospace is expected to report earnings per share (EPS) of $0.1381 and revenue of $19.17 million with an EPS surprise percentage of +2.36%. On Friday, October 9, 2026, Delta Air Lines (DAL) and Nurix (NRIX) are scheduled to release their earnings reports. Delta Air Lines is expected to report revenue of $17.59 billion with an EPS surprise percentage of -0.05%, and Nurix is expected to report EPS of -$0.611 with an EPS surprise percentage of -1.50%. The sources don't provide a definitive answer for other earnings reports on this date.

An earnings calendar is the timetable (usually in the form of a quarterly schedule) that lists the dates when publicly traded companies are scheduled to announce their quarterly or annual earnings. These calendars offer at-a-glance information on expected earnings releases, making it easier for investors, both seasoned and rookies, to plan their investment strategies accordingly. [...] The Earnings Calendar is laid out by date in a table with sortable columns. The buttons at the top of the table allow the user to look back at the releases that occurred both ‘yesterday,’ and ‘today,’ but also upcoming releases grouped by tomorrow, this week, and next week.

Earnings Calendar screenshot with filters highlighted [...] A robust earnings calendar is an indispensable tool for time-poor investors looking to gain an edge in the market. Using an earnings calendar can help investors to stay informed, recognize potential opportunities, manage risk, and plan investment strategy more effectively. It grants investors a deeper understanding of market trends and allows them to make more strategic and confident investment decisions.

## FAQ

### What is the Investing.com Earnings Calendar?

The Earnings Calendar is a free tool that tracks earnings report dates for publicly traded companies worldwide. It displays EPS and Revenue forecasts alongside actual results once released, so you can compare analyst expectations with reported outcomes in a single view.

### What is an earnings surprise? [...] The Earnings Calendar informs traders of quarterly and annual corporate earnings results versus expectations in real time. By default, earnings are listed in order of release date. Each earnings release includes the company’s ticker symbol, full name and the period for which the company is expected to release its earnings. The consensus forecast for each company’s EPS is listed alongside the prior period’s value.
